title: Early Black Friday MacBook Air Deals: Save $200?
description: Early Black Friday sales have started, offering significant discounts on Apple products like the MacBook Air and Apple Watch, as well as Sony headphones. Source: Mashable, MacRumors This is a short news summary of early holiday tech deals.
narration: Early Black Friday deals are already live. According to MacRumors, Apple's early Black Friday sales have officially started with great discounts. Mashable highlights an early deal where you can save two hundred dollars on the MacBook Air. The early Amazon promotions also offer a chance to grab Sony's best headphones at reduced prices. These early holiday savings include discounts on the Apple Watch, a major price cut on the MacBook Air, and reduced prices on Sony's best headphones.
